subject: Improve cluster cant failover log conditions (#780)
reason: The change only alters diagnostic logging in clusterLogCantFailover: it removes the suppression of the cant-failover log while the primary's FAIL state is recent, and lowers the re-log period from 10s to 1s. No command reply, cluster election decision, replication, persistence, or data path changes; cant_failover_reason is never exposed outside cluster_legacy.c and was already assigned before the removed early return. The fuzzer's oracles cannot observe log verbosity, so no scenario can reach or distinguish this change.
